questions.questionText: Which words are usually stressed in a sentence?

options.text: content words: nouns, main verbs, adjectives

explanations.general: Correct answer: content words: nouns, main verbs, adjectives

questions.questionText: In “I need to buy some bread”, which word is weak?
“No, it's on THURSDAY” — the stress shows…
In English, weak words are said faster to keep the rhythm.

questions.questionText: “I didn't say SHE stole the money” means…
